description: Rug and honeypot check for a token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: a simulated buy and sell against its main pool (can it be sold, buy/sell tax; nothing is sent), a 0-100 risk score with reasons, pass/warn/fail checks, the deployer's past launches, any tax raised since we first saw it, price and liquidity. Send the fingerprint back as since to see what changed. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

chain.description: Chain the token is on; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base

since.description: watch.fingerprint from an earlier call; adds what changed since then

name: token_risk_check
